nodes.label: Bed heating limit (70 C, refused below 15 C sensor)
nodes.community_name: README app docs: Duplicator 4 Studio app
nodes.norm_label: bed heating limit (70 c, refused below 15 c sensor)
nodes.rationale: Failed thermistor reads below room temperature; heating with a broken sensor would run away, so heating is refused below 15 C and capped at 70 C.

nodes.label: Extruder speed limit 25 mm/s
nodes.community_name: README app docs: Duplicator 4 Studio app
nodes.rationale: Very short slicer moves could over-speed the extruder.

nodes.label: Print start priming (settle, purge blob, double prime line)
nodes.community_name: README app docs: Duplicator 4 Studio app
nodes.norm_label: print start priming (settle, purge blob, double prime line)
nodes.rationale: Nozzle was empty for the first seconds of a print.

nodes.label: Heater watchdog
nodes.community_name: README app docs: Duplicator 4 Studio app
nodes.rationale: Switches heaters off on implausibly low readings, no warm-up, bed over-temperature or jumps, because the bed thermistor wire has failed before.

nodes.label: Small-layer slowdown (no part-cooling fan)
nodes.community_name: README app docs: Duplicator 4 Studio app

nodes.label: Slice-Convert-Check-Print pipeline
nodes.community_name: README app docs: Duplicator 4 Studio app

nodes.label: Software 33 mm nozzle spacing (never switch to T1)
nodes.community_name: README app docs: Duplicator 4 Studio app
nodes.norm_label: software 33 mm nozzle spacing (never switch to t1)
nodes.rationale: Stored T1 offset in firmware is bogus (~228 mm), so the tool offset is applied in software.

nodes.label: Independent s3g/x3g implementation (no Sailfish/GPX/ReplicatorG code)
nodes.community_name: README app docs: Duplicator 4 Studio app

nodes.label: LGPL-3.0 compliance for Qt (relinkable via public source + build script)
nodes.community_name: README app docs: Duplicator 4 Studio app
nodes.norm_label: lgpl-3.0 compliance for qt (relinkable via public source + build script)
nodes.rationale: Qt libraries are unmodified and the full source plus tools/build_exe.py are public, so users can rebuild with their own Qt/PySide6.

nodes.label: PrusaSlicer AGPL-3.0 used as separate program
nodes.community_name: README app docs: Duplicator 4 Studio app
nodes.norm_label: prusaslicer agpl-3.0 used as separate program
nodes.rationale: Run as a separate downloaded program, not bundled in the repo or exe, keeping AGPL obligations separate from the GPL-3.0 app.
